Book questions

What this book is for

Answered from the same facts the shelf shows, nothing more.

Who is Sadda Punjab - Punjab General Knowledge for?

Punjab GK theory in Punjabi medium: history, geography, culture and economy of Punjab in one book.

What does Sadda Punjab - Punjab General Knowledge cover?

Punjab general knowledge in Punjabi medium - the history, geography, culture, literature and economy of Punjab as asked in Punjab government exams.

Which exams is Sadda Punjab - Punjab General Knowledge useful for?

Punjab Police, PSSSB, Punjab Civil Services, Patwari, General competitive.
